_comment: Rumors (GDD 8, Phase 3 step 2). witnesses: who tells the rumor (English working text; Russian: rumor_witness.<id> in locale/strings.csv). zones: per zone of the district map, the rumor pictures (art/ui/RUMOR__art__<id>.webp) and the creature tags that make a rumor land there more often. gossip: lines heard during a tavern shift (Russian: rumor_gossip.<id>).

witnesses.text: A washerwoman at the pump swears by every saint:
A drunk in the Lantern & Hook tells it while someone keeps pouring:
A grubby urchin whispers it for a copper:
The night watchman says it without looking at you:
An Ash Sister wrote it down from a patient's words:
An unsigned leaflet is pinned to the post by the bonfire:
The widow from the third floor has not slept for three nights:

gossip.text: The Pale Hounds were drinking here again. They talk about the Hunter's Register as if they owned it.
Grey candles burn in the Old Chapel at night, though no priest has been there for years.
The guards on the north wall turned the guns inward last week. Nobody says why.
Someone swears the Broken Hoist creaked by itself at midnight, as if something rode it up.
The rent collector raised the price for the attic rooms again. 'Safety,' he says.
The Ash Sisters ran out of bandages. They boil the old ones now.
Children dare each other to go down to the Fog Cellars. Fewer come back to brag.
Fresh offerings at the God in the Wall every morning. Somebody is praying hard.
